subject.title: fix(zalo): bound proxy fetcher cache to 64 entries

question: Should proxy-fetch disposal become a public PROXY_FETCH_CLOSE symbol contract, or should the SDK encapsulate disposal behind a named helper/resource API?
rationale: Both shapes can implement the bug fix, but selecting the permanent third-party plugin contract is a compatibility and ownership choice that repository policy does not permit automation to make implicitly.

options.title: Use a named disposal helper
options.body: Expose a narrow helper such as closeProxyFetch(fetcher) so plugins can release proxy resources without depending directly on hidden symbol metadata.

options.title: Approve the symbol contract
options.body: Keep PROXY_FETCH_CLOSE as the supported additive API and add explicit documentation and semantic compatibility coverage for it.

options.title: Keep lifecycle plugin-local
options.body: Retain the ProxyAgent resource alongside each Zalo cache entry and close it locally, avoiding any new public SDK surface at the cost of duplicating proxy-wrapper ownership.

recommendation.title: Use a named disposal helper
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow helper such as closeProxyFetch(fetcher) so plugins can release proxy resources without depending directly on hidden symbol metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Zalo conversion and plugin-boundary landing make steipete the strongest available owner for this API-shape decision.
